heading: Legal content management
subtitle: Draft, preview, publish and restore public content. Every publication retains its revision history.
confirmPublish: Publish this draft to customers now?
confirmRestore: Create a new draft from this revision? The current published version will not change.
previewHint: Preview is isolated from scripts. HTML is filtered by the server before publication.
noDraft: There is no draft to publish.
required: Titles and content are required in both languages.
initialNotice: No legal documents have been published. New customer registrations are blocked until an admin publishes both the terms and privacy policy.
dirty: There are unsaved changes. Save a new draft revision before publishing.
editorHint: Headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, bold/italic and links are supported. The server keeps only allowed HTML.
templateConfirm: Replace your current content with a starter outline?
noChanges: The latest draft content is displayed.
